        16                  THE SECRETARY:    By Senator

        17       Fuschillo, Legislative Resolution Number 3974,

        18       memorializing Governor Eliot Spitzer to

        19       proclaim 2008 as the Year of the Defibrillator

        20       in the State of New York.

        21                  "WHEREAS, Death from sudden cardiac

        22       arrest is a major health problem, one which

        23       receives much less attention than heart attack

        24       and cardiovascular disease.  It is one of the

        25       leading causes of death in the United States,



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        57



         1       striking some 335,000 Americans each year; and

         2                  "WHEREAS, There are tools available

         3       to increase survival rates from sudden cardiac

         4       arrest, including cardiopulmonary

         5       resuscitation, but it is often not enough to

         6       save a life.  A lifesaving pulse of

         7       electricity, known as defibrillation, is

         8       frequently needed to restore the heart's

         9       normal rhythm; and

        10                  "WHEREAS, Studies show that sudden

        11       cardiac arrest survival rates decrease

        12       7 percent to 10 percent every minute the

        13       victim is without defibrillation.  The

        14       difference between life and death is only a

        15       matter of minutes.  Having a defibrillator

        16       readily accessible saves precious time in

        17       helping victims survive a cardiac emergency;

        18       and

        19                  "WHEREAS, Attendant to such

        20       concern, and in full accord with its

        21       long-standing traditions, it is the sense of

        22       this Legislative Body to encourage

        23       organizations, institutions, and citizens

        24       across New York State to educate themselves

        25       about sudden cardiac arrest and to work toward



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        58



         1       the broad availability of automated external

         2       defibrillators; and

         3                  "WHEREAS, Founded by Merrick

         4       residents Jill and Craig Levine in memory of

         5       their nine-year-old son, who died tragically

         6       of sudden cardiac arrest in 2005, the Robbie

         7       Levine Foundation will undertake a grassroots

         8       campaign throughout 2008 to raise awareness

         9       about the importance of having defibrillators

        10       available when children are playing sports;

        11       and

        12                  "WHEREAS, Since its inception, the

        13       Robbie Levine Foundation has raised over

        14       $150,000, donated defibrillators to several

        15       different youth sports leagues throughout

        16       New York State, as well as a Boy Scout camp,

        17       organized training sessions to teach people

        18       how to use defibrillators, and developed an

        19       educational DVD.  The organization also holds

        20       an annual 5K run and other events designed to

        21       raise awareness about the importance of

        22       defibrillators; and

        23                  "WHEREAS, In the 2007-2008 budget,

        24       $1.7 million was secured in the 2007-2008

        25       budget for the New York State Police to



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        59



         1       purchase automated external defibrillators --

         2       AEDs -- for use in all on-duty State Police

         3       vehicles and to train state troopers in their

         4       use.  By the beginning of 2008, all 6,000

         5       State Police employees are expected to have

         6       completed AED training; and

         7                  "WHEREAS, In addition, the New York

         8       State Office of General Services, in

         9       cooperation with its tenant agencies, is

        10       implementing a new lifesaving 'AED Program,'

        11       which will place automated external

        12       defibrillators in key locations throughout its

        13       facilities and train employee volunteers to be

        14       AED first-responders; and

        15                  "WHEREAS, This Legislative Body

        16       recognizes the critical importance of

        17       increasing the survival rate from sudden

        18       cardiac arrest and urges all citizens to learn

        19       how to use automated external defibrillators

        20       so that we may reduce the number of deaths

        21       from sudden cardiac arrest in New York State;

        22       now, therefore, be it

        23                  "RESOLVED, That this Legislative

        24       Body pause in its deliberations to memorialize

        25       Governor Eliot Spitzer to proclaim 2008 as the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        60



         1       Year of the Defibrillator in the State of

         2       New York; and be it further

         3                  "RESOLVED, That copies of this

         4       resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted

         5       to The Honorable Eliot Spitzer, Governor of

         6       the State of New York, and to the Robbie

         7       Levine Foundation."

         8                  ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:    Senator

         9       Fuschillo.

        10                  SENATOR FUSCHILLO:    Thank you

        11       very much, Mr. President.

        12                  It was a beautiful day in September

        13       of 2005 where a dad, who is all too well known

        14       now in my community where I live in Merrick,

        15       was coaching his son's Little League team.

        16       They were practicing behind the school called

        17       Lakeside, Levy Lakeside, named after Senator

        18       Norman Levy, who spent so many years in this

        19       body.

        20                  It was the end of practice, and the

        21       kids at the end of practice round the bases.

        22       And the little boy, Robbie Levine, who has

        23       become a household name in my community, was

        24       rounding the bases.  And the father now talks

        25       about how his speed had excelled; he never saw



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        61



         1       him run so fast in his life.

         2                  Rounded first base, rounded second

         3       base, rounded third base.  On his way home, he

         4       just collapsed.  And he died, the poor little

         5       boy.  Nine years old.

         6                  And for a moment in my community,

         7       time stopped.  You could hear a pin drop even

         8       on the streets when the words went through

         9       everybody's houses that a 9-year-old boy died.

        10       Nobody really knew who this boy was.  But as I

        11       said, it's a household name.

        12                  And Senator Bruno said it best

        13       yesterday, on the passing of his wife, Bobbie,

        14       that when somebody passes away you reflect on

        15       your own life and your own priorities.  And

        16       the Levines, Craig and Jill, have done that.

        17       And they've created a foundation called

        18       Forever Nine, to honor the memory of Robbie

        19       Levine.  It's the Forever Nine Robbie Levine

        20       Foundation.

        21                  And since the passing of this young

        22       boy, they have raised more than $150,000 to

        23       buy defibrillators and donate them to youth

        24       sport organizations throughout the state, to

        25       promote the awareness that AEDs save lives and



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        62



         1       every minute during sudden cardiac arrest

         2       counts.

         3                  So what we're trying to do with

         4       this resolution is raise awareness throughout

         5       New York State.  We want parents to be trained

         6       in the use of AEDs.  We want parents, when

         7       they step on the field or in a gym, to say:

         8       "Where's the defibrillator?"  And if it's not

         9       there, "Why?"

        10                  And that's what this campaign is

        11       all about.  I thank you, Mr. President, for

        12       the opportunity to speak on it.
